reason: I already have my gummies that I reorder when they run out, and I'm not looking to switch. Two capsules every day is not something I want to swallow when I have something I like.
objection: Capsules to swallow every day, and I already have a brand I trust and reorder. I don't see why I'd add or swap for something I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: If it were a gummy or a powder instead of capsules, or if a friend I trust swore it helped her sleep.
